notes: Measured pixel-exact (max 1 level) on AE 2026 8 bpc (Stretch 40 / Direction 50, Stretch -30 / Direction 120, Center default): smear direction d = (sin th, -cos th) (Direction th clockwise from up), reversed for negative Stretch; the half-plane behind the line through Center perpendicular to d is untouched; at distance u > 0 past that line a pixel reads the source at distance g(u) = u / (1 + u*|Stretch|/R) along d (same perpendicular offset), R = half the layer DIAGONAL sqrt(w^2+h^2)/2 (the fitted saturation length L*|Stretch| = 367.155 for both settings; half diagonal of 640x360 = 367.151). Center is a pixel centre (AE point (x,y) = pixel-corner coordinates (x+0.5, y+0.5)): the -30/120 setting needs exactly that half-pixel shift (0.68 px along d), the 40/50 setting is insensitive. Source read with bilinear interpolation of the premultiplied pixels, transparent outside the layer. Stretch 0 = identity. The half-diagonal law is fitted on one layer size (640x360): it could instead be another size-derived length that coincides here (e.g. not checked on non-16:9 layers). R is computed from the canvas size, so the node's fxPad must stay 0 (a pad would change R; the effect never draws outside the layer). Held-out setting (Stretch 60, Center 200,200) not inspected. Not reproduced: Compositing Options (AE 4).
